Paytm Shares Rise After Bernstein Revises Target Price

Paytm's shares experienced a 10% increase following a revision of its target price by Bernstein to ₹2,200. Bernstein's analysis suggests a potential 36% upside for the company, partly attributed to the possibility of UPI MDR fees being reinstated. This development has positively impacted the company's stock valuation.
